summary: Aya Gold & Silver Inc. furnished a Form 6-K announcing record Q2-2026 silver production results at its Zgounder Silver Mine and Boumadine pyrite reclaim operation in Morocco. The filing reports a 61% year-over-year increase in consolidated production to 1.68 million silver equivalent ounces, with record processing rates of 3,889 tpd and mining rate of 4,880 tpd. This is a routine operational update on production metrics, not a special-situation transaction. No deal terms, board recommendations, or structural changes are present. The filing is analogous to a standard business update in US reporting.
